observations.finding: 23/50 Hallmark pathways significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.00025). Top effects: HEME_METABOLISM down (SMD -0.986), FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM down (-0.911), ADIPOGENESIS down (-0.859), DNA_REPAIR up (0.867), MYC_TARGETS_V2 up (0.743), EMT up (0.785).
